scene_independence_caveat: 30 distinct predeclared scene groups/initial hashes, within three shared scene families; not 30 new object categories or OOD domains.

confirmed: All 30 admitted original TRAIN T2 demonstrations have approach, close, align, contact, push, detach, withdraw and hold anchors.
Manifest phase membership exactly matches original raw teacher_stage for all 18,030 valid H40 anchors.
Every raw episode has 640 actually committed supervised actions plus one terminal observation with supervision=null.
Detach anchors are 756/18,030 (4.19%); detach+withdraw anchors are 2,256/18,030 (12.51%).
No H40 window lies entirely in detach, because every detach segment is shorter than the 2s H40 horizon; many valid cross-stage windows contain detach.
not_proved: That the measured stage imbalance is the unique cause of M1 failure
That uniform or event-balanced reweighting improves autonomous task success
That 18,030 overlapping windows are independent demonstrations
That future sampler forecasts are actual optimizer consumption
